source_basis.orthophoto_publisher: Gouvernement Princier de Monaco, DSN, 2019 orthophoto
source_basis.terrain_grid_limits: Retained RGE Alti query at 2 m request spacing; spacing is not a claim of 2 m source accuracy. Survey epoch and vertical errors remain unverified.

source_roof.source_outline: Use the literal IGN BDTopo 3D ring as the eave outline; do not widen the OSM body or join the separate L-shaped roof feature.
source_roof.observed_plan_shape: 2019 ortho shows a broad muted gray-green roof with a long near east-west ridge and four hip planes; the ridge is visible in the central roof seams.
source_roof.roof_material_estimate: Matte muted gray-green metal/slate appearance based on 2019 orthophoto pixels only; no material tag or ground-level material source exists.
source_roof.roof_surface_model: Four hipped planes from the IGN eave ring to the estimated ridge line. The maximum 89.2 m absolute roof elevation anchors the ridge, not a flat full-footprint cap. Eave altitudes remain the measured boundary values 82.1–82.8 m absolute.
source_roof.roof_overhang_and_ridge_length_status: Ridge inset and roof-plane intersections are architectural plan estimates; IGN has 2.5 m plan / 1.5 m vertical precision, and the orthophoto does not provide a surveyed ridge polyline.

architecture: Literal main OSM body and IGN eaves/ridge envelope, with an estimated front-only mansard break and photo-qualified garden-facing loggias, rose columns, balcony bands/openwork rails, dormers and pediment. Balcony/ornament projections are estimates; main occupancy and terrain cutout stay literal. Wall feet use actual emitted surrounding Ground and retained2m RGE observations; no terrain/property pad flattening.
floor_reconstruction: Six horizontal3.6m principal levels begin at60.5m absolute; nominal base/spacing remain estimates. The developer photo supports roughly six visible levels; its nine-floor project description may include hidden/lower storeys and does not establish nine exposed rows. Plain unphotographed side-window rhythm remains an estimate. Ground clips buried lower walls/windows without tilting floors.
exclusions: No flattening of the courtyard, pool or hillside.
No extension of BATIMENT0000000074074420 (the separate L-shaped roof/terrace feature).
No transfer of façade details from Casa Mia or other neighboring properties.
No treating the maximum IGN roof altitude as a uniform eave or building-body height.
status: Bounded source authoring in progress; native import and fresh cooked review required.

facade_estimates.registration: Plausible garden-facing south elevation; no measured photographer pose
facade_estimates.appearance: Original restrained openwork motif, not a survey of every iron scroll; existing licensed materials, no reference pixels used as textures.
